  cen_cenelec_stage = (("FprEN" / "prEN")) as stage
  cen_cenelec_type = (("TR" / "TS")) as type
  cen_cenelec_guide = ("Guide") as guide
  cen_cenelec_number = (((1*%x30-39) (*(" " (1*%x30-39))))) as number
  cen_cenelec_part = (1*(%x30-39 / "-")) as part
  cen_cenelec_version = (" " "V" (1*%x30-39) "." (1*%x30-39) "." (1*%x30-39)) as version
  cen_cenelec_year = (4digit) as year
  cen_cenelec_adopted = (((("ISO" / "IEC" / "CISPR")) *((!(cen_cenelec_supplement) !(" FRAG") (%x01-09 / %x0B-10FFFF))))) as adopted

  cen_cenelec_supplements_month = (2digit) as supplements_month
  cen_cenelec_supplement_corrigendum = {
    ("/" as supplements_slash / "+" as supplements_plus)
    "AC" as supplement_kind [cen_cenelec_supplement_number] [":" cen_cenelec_supplements_year] ["-" cen_cenelec_supplements_month]
  }
  cen_cenelec_supplement_amendment = {
    ("/" as supplements_slash / "+" as supplements_plus)
    "A" as supplement_kind cen_cenelec_supplement_number [":" cen_cenelec_supplements_year]
  }
  cen_cenelec_supplement = ( cen_cenelec_supplement_corrigendum / cen_cenelec_supplement_amendment ) as supplement
  cen_cenelec_supplements = (1*cen_cenelec_supplement) as supplements

  # Identifier rule: the canonical template first, then the
  # declared alternates (parse-in spellings; they normalize to the
  # canonical render face).

    ( cen_cenelec_stage " " cen_cenelec_number ["-" cen_cenelec_part] [cen_cenelec_version] [":" cen_cenelec_year] / cen_cenelec_publisher [cen_cenelec_copublishers] " " cen_cenelec_guide " " cen_cenelec_number ["-" cen_cenelec_part] [":" cen_cenelec_year] / cen_cenelec_publisher [cen_cenelec_copublishers] " " cen_cenelec_adopted / cen_cenelec_publisher [cen_cenelec_copublishers] ["/" cen_cenelec_type] " " cen_cenelec_number ["-" cen_cenelec_part] [cen_cenelec_version] [":" cen_cenelec_year] ) [cen_cenelec_supplements [" FRAG" cen_cenelec_fragment_number]]
    / cen_cenelec_publisher [cen_cenelec_copublishers] " " cen_cenelec_type " " cen_cenelec_number ["-" cen_cenelec_part] [cen_cenelec_version] [":" cen_cenelec_year] [cen_cenelec_supplements [" FRAG" cen_cenelec_fragment_number]]
  }

    publisher -> publisher (string)
    copublisher -> copublisher (string)

    stage -> stage (string)
    type -> type (string)
    guide -> guide (string)
    number -> number (string)
    part -> part (string)
    version -> version (string)
    year -> year (string)
    adopted -> adopted (string)
    fragment_number -> fragment_number (string)
    supplement -> supplements[].supplement (raw)
  }
